recognize_zh: 數個紅血球內可見成團、較粗大不規則的深藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），另有些細胞呈散在的細小點狀（疑似嗜鹼性點彩）；背景有大量標靶細胞（上方箭頭）與拉長的鐮刀／船形紅血球（下方箭頭），符合鐮刀型貧血。
features: Coarse, irregular basophilic granules in small clusters within several red cells (Pappenheimer bodies)
Some red cells with finer punctate dots scattered across the cell, possibly representing basophilic stippling
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows abundant target cells and an elongated boat-shaped sickle form. Several erythrocytes contain clustered, coarse, irregular basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, and a few show finer dots distributed across the cell that may represent basophilic stippling. On Wright stain alone these two inclusions cannot be fully separated; a Prussian blue stain will identify the iron-positive Pappenheimer bodies. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Stippling is evenly dispersed throughout the red cell and is Prussian blue negative, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are clustered and iron positive.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, smooth-contoured nuclear remnants rather than multiple irregular granules.
Hb SC shows target cells with fewer classic sickle forms and characteristic crystal or 'Washington monument' cells; Hb HPLC separates them.
